roles.description: Full system configuration, bulk operations, user permissions & global settings
CSR impact metrics, state/district aggregate views, overall program analytics
Block & school supervisor, teacher attendance verification, course distribution
Daily student attendance marking, course progress reporting, village student master
Personal attendance record, course progress roadmap, certificates & badges

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure standard Tailwind utility styles and Shadcn primitive components are used for forms, dialogs, dropdowns, and buttons.
The header must include the global Academic Year dropdown, active role badge, search bar, and user profile drawer.

Management Dashboard MUST feature 13 distinct KPI cards and 14 clear interactive charts (Recharts) covering attendance rates, block wise performance, course completion, village breakdown, gender distribution, and year-over-year trends.
Student Master view should support filtering by Block, Village, School, Grade, and Gender, with instant search and CSV/Excel export triggers.
Daily Attendance Marking view should support quick toggle per student, batch present/absent buttons, and sticky date header.
Bulk Excel Upload must provide a clear 4-step wizard: 1. Download Template, 2. Drag & Drop File, 3. Review Validation & Error Summary, 4. Confirm Import.
Provide bottom navigation on mobile devices with key routes (Dashboard, Attendance, Students, Courses, Reports).
Ensure sonner toasts confirm actions like Attendance Submitted, Student Added, Excel Exported, and Year Switch.
